title: Astro Portal API v1 open session package import
description: POST /v1/sessions/{id}/imports/preview and .../imports/confirm (the package contract itself is packages/astro-contracts/schemas/session-package/). Both routes share one request shape: the exact raw text of manifest.json (`manifestJson`) and of checksums.sha256 (`checksums`), plus an optional `documents` map carrying the inline bytes of every metric-log/event-log/other asset. Image and progression assets are never inlined in this request — they are stored media and must already have been uploaded ahead of the import through POST /v1/uploads (capture.schema.json), then resolved here by the sha256 checksums.sha256 names, on the same content-addressed doctrine every other capture write already follows. `preview` validates, checks idempotency and reports exactly what would happen, persisting nothing; `confirm` does the same and then persists, idempotently keyed on the manifest's own fingerprint (the SHA-256 of manifestJson's exact bytes) at the tenant level: re-confirming the same bytes, for this session or any other, replays the first result and writes nothing new. See api/v1.md, section "Open session package import".

importRequest.description: The shared request body of both routes. `manifestJson` and `checksums` MUST be the exact raw text of the package's own manifest.json and checksums.sha256 files -- not a re-serialized JSON object -- so the manifest fingerprint this contract's idempotency depends on is stable and reproducible. `documents` is required only when the manifest lists at least one metric-log/event-log/other asset; a request omitting an entry a listed document asset needs is refused, never silently skipped.

documents.description: Package-root-relative path (exactly as it appears in the manifest) to base64-encoded file content, for every metric-log/event-log/other asset only.

recognized.description: What the package contains, exactly as `confirm` would persist it -- the dry-run report's core (README, "Portal import begins with a dry-run report showing recognized data, warnings, visibility, and exact transfer size").

warning.description: A non-fatal note about one asset -- the package still imports, but something about it is worth surfacing. `capture_attached_elsewhere`: this asset's bytes are already a capture belonging to a different session, and that association will not change (a capture's session is fixed at its first creation, everywhere in this contract). `capture_session_unset`: this asset's bytes are an existing capture with no session at all; confirming this import will not retroactively attach it.

previewResponse.description: 200 response of POST .../imports/preview. Persists nothing, always -- calling this repeatedly for the same or a different package never changes portal state.

confirmResponse.description: 200 response of POST .../imports/confirm, on the first confirm of this manifest fingerprint AND on every later replay alike -- `alreadyImported` is the only field that tells them apart; every other field replays the first confirm's own recorded values. `capturesLinked`/`documentsAttached` are present only on the first confirm (a replay does not recompute them from a request it may not even re-derive the same way).

refusal.description: The route-specific refusal codes, on top of the generic v1 error envelope (api/v1.md, "Error envelope"). `invalid_path`: a manifest asset path fails either of the two independent traversal checks the session-package README requires. `checksum_mismatch`: a checksums.sha256 line is missing/malformed/duplicated, an inline document's bytes do not hash to its declared digest, or an already-uploaded capture's byte size disagrees with the manifest. `asset_not_uploaded`: an image/progression asset's sha256 is not yet a capture in this tenant -- upload it through POST /v1/uploads first. `entitlement_read_only`: the soft-downgrade write gate, exactly as POST /v1/uploads already answers it.
